#CA
## data prep
```{r}

# make sure you've run FIA-fire-severity and control-plot-species before running this script

library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# get coordinates for your filtered plots, CA_PLOT_forest_type is CA_PLOT filtered to selected forest types
CA_PLOT_coords <- CA_PLOT_forest_type %>%
  dplyr::select(plot_id, LON, LAT) %>%   
  distinct()

# convert to a terra SpatVector, matching raster CRS
plot_pts <- vect(CA_PLOT_coords, geom = c("LON", "LAT"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# do plot coordinates and climate rasters use the same CRS? #reproject to coordinate system of climate stack
if (!same.crs(plot_pts, climate_stack)) {
  plot_pts <- project(plot_pts, crs(climate_stack))
}

climate_vals <- terra::extract(climate_stack, plot_pts)

# rename columns explicitly (skip the first column, which is "ID")
colnames(climate_vals) <- c("ID", "ppt", "def", "vpd", "aet", "pet", "tmax", "tmin")

# extract climate for plots based on plot coordinates
CA_PLOT_climate <- bind_cols(CA_PLOT_coords, climate_vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID))

plot_climate_vs_trait <- function(climate_var, trait_data, trait_col, trait_label) {
  CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
    mutate(species_clean = gsub("_", " ", species)) %>%
    left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
    group_by(species_clean) %>%
    summarise(mean_val = mean(.data[[climate_var]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(trait_data, by = c("species_clean" = "scientificName")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[trait_col]])) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mean_val, y = .data[[trait_col]])) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_text(aes(label = species_clean), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey50") +
    labs(x = paste("Mean", climate_var), y = trait_label) +
    theme_minimal()
}

```

```{r}
ggplot(CA_PLOT_climate, aes(x = LON, y = LAT, color = ppt)) +

for (var in climate_vars) {

}
```

## tcrit
```{r}
# create a tree-level dataset where each row = one individual tree, carrying:species name, the plot it was measured in, the plot's climate values, and that species' average Tcrit
# CA_TREE_forest_type_species is CA_TREE filtered to the plots in CA_PLOT_forest_type
species_climate_full <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
  left_join(tcrit_species_avg, by = "species") %>% #tcrit_species_avg is species averages of Tcrit
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit))

# species_climate_summary is a species-level table (one row per species) with species' mean climate across its occurrences that species' climate variability (sd) across its occurrences that species' Tcrit value 

climate_vars <- c("ppt", "def", "vpd", "aet", "pet", "tmax", "tmin")

species_climate_summary <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(climate_vars), list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(tcrit_species_avg, by = "species") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit))

```

### CWM
```{r}
tcrit_avg <- tcrit_df %>%
  filter(run != "run7") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(Tcrit = mean(Tcrit, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# x-axis: each species' average value of the current climate variable, computed across all the plots that species occurs in. y-axis: each species' average critical temperature (heat tolerance trait) 
# no significant trends
for (var in climate_vars) {
  
  plot_data <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
    left_join(CA_PLOT_climate, by = "plot_id") %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(mean_val = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(tcrit_avg, by = "species") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Tcrit))
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = mean_val, y = Tcrit)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_text(aes(label = species), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey50") +
    labs(x = paste("Mean", var), y = "Mean Tcrit (°C)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7))
  
  print(p)
}


# filter to plot x year combinations with complete Tcrit coverage
species_with_tcrit <- tcrit_df %>%
  filter(run != "run7") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(Tcrit = mean(Tcrit, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tcrit))

complete_tcrit_plots <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  distinct(plot_id, INVYR, species) %>%
  left_join(species_with_tcrit, by = "species") %>%
  group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(species),
    n_species_with_tcrit = n_distinct(species[!is.na(Tcrit)]),
    complete_tcrit = n_species == n_species_with_tcrit,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(complete_tcrit)

# quick check: how many plot x year combos qualify, and how many species are lost to
nrow(complete_tcrit_plots)
n_distinct(paste(complete_tcrit_plots$plot_id, complete_tcrit_plots$INVYR))

species_ba_by_plot <- CA_TREE_forest_type_species %>%
  semi_join(complete_tcrit_plots, by = c("plot_id", "INVYR")) %>%
  mutate(basal_area = pi * (DIA / 2)^2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(basal_area)) %>%
  group_by(plot_id, INVYR, species) %>%
  summarise(species_basal_area = sum(basal_area), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
  mutate(
    total_plot_basal_area = sum(species_basal_area),
    relative_abundance = species_basal_area / total_plot_basal_area  # this is p_{i,k}
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

head(species_ba_by_plot)
# check relative abundances sum to 1 within a plot
species_ba_by_plot %>%
  filter(plot_id == "6_1_15_54352", INVYR == 2004) %>%
  summarise(check_sum = sum(relative_abundance))

cwm_tcrit_by_plot_year <- species_ba_by_plot %>%
  left_join(species_with_tcrit, by = "species") %>%
  group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    cwm_tcrit = sum(relative_abundance * Tcrit),  # CWM_{j,k} = sum(p_{i,k} * t_{i,j})
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# which species dominate which plots?
species_ba_by_plot %>%
```

# expand states
### extract climate
```{r}
extract_plot_climate <- function(plot_forest_type_df) {
  coords <- plot_forest_type_df %>%
    dplyr::select(plot_id, LON, LAT) %>%
    distinct()
  
  pts <- vect(coords, geom = c("LON", "LAT"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
  if (!same.crs(pts, climate_stack)) {
    pts <- project(pts, crs(climate_stack))
  }
  
  vals <- terra::extract(climate_stack, pts)
  colnames(vals) <- c("ID", "ppt", "def", "vpd", "aet", "pet", "tmax", "tmin")
  
  bind_cols(coords, vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID))
}

OR_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(OR_PLOT_forest_type)
WA_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(WA_PLOT_forest_type)
ID_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(ID_PLOT_forest_type)
MT_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(MT_PLOT_forest_type)
CO_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(CO_PLOT_forest_type)
WY_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(WY_PLOT_forest_type)
AZ_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(AZ_PLOT_forest_type)
NM_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(NM_PLOT_forest_type)
UT_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(UT_PLOT_forest_type)
NV_PLOT_climate <- extract_plot_climate(NV_PLOT_forest_type)

```
### CWM
```{r}
build_species_ba_by_plot <- function(tree_df, species_trait_df, trait_col) {
  
  # which plot x year combos have 100% trait coverage
  complete_plots <- tree_df %>%
    distinct(plot_id, INVYR, species) %>%
    left_join(species_trait_df, by = "species") %>%
    group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
    summarise(
      n_species = n_distinct(species),
      n_species_with_trait = n_distinct(species[!is.na(.data[[trait_col]])]),
      complete = n_species == n_species_with_trait,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(complete)
  
  # species-level basal area and relative abundance, restricted to complete plots
  species_ba <- tree_df %>%
    semi_join(complete_plots, by = c("plot_id", "INVYR")) %>%
    mutate(basal_area = pi * (DIA / 2)^2) %>%
    filter(!is.na(basal_area)) %>%
    group_by(plot_id, INVYR, species) %>%
    summarise(species_basal_area = sum(basal_area), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
    mutate(
      total_plot_basal_area = sum(species_basal_area),
      relative_abundance = species_basal_area / total_plot_basal_area
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  list(complete_plots = complete_plots, species_ba = species_ba)
}

compute_cwm <- function(species_ba_df, species_trait_df, trait_col, cwm_name) {
  species_ba_df %>%
    left_join(species_trait_df, by = "species") %>%
    group_by(plot_id, INVYR) %>%
    summarise(!!cwm_name := sum(relative_abundance * .data[[trait_col]]), .groups = "drop")
}

```

```{r}
  CA = CA_TREE_forest_type_species, OR = OR_TREE_forest_type_species,
  WA = WA_TREE_forest_type_species, ID = ID_TREE_forest_type_species,
  MT = MT_TREE_forest_type_species, CO = CO_TREE_forest_type_species,
  WY = WY_TREE_forest_type_species, AZ = AZ_TREE_forest_type_species,
  NM = NM_TREE_forest_type_species, UT = UT_TREE_forest_type_species,
  NV = NV_TREE_forest_type_species
)

states_climate_data <- list(
  CA = CA_PLOT_climate, OR = OR_PLOT_climate, WA = WA_PLOT_climate,
  ID = ID_PLOT_climate, MT = MT_PLOT_climate, CO = CO_PLOT_climate,
  WY = WY_PLOT_climate, AZ = AZ_PLOT_climate, NM = NM_PLOT_climate,
  UT = UT_PLOT_climate, NV = NV_PLOT_climate
)

cwm_tcrit_all_states <- list()
cwm_p50_all_states <- list()

for (st in names(states_tree_data)) {
  
  tree_df <- states_tree_data[[st]]
  
  # Tcrit
  tcrit_result <- build_species_ba_by_plot(tree_df, species_with_tcrit, "Tcrit")
  cwm_tcrit_all_states[[st]] <- compute_cwm(tcrit_result$species_ba, species_with_tcrit, "Tcrit", "cwm_tcrit") %>%
    left_join(states_climate_data[[st]], by = "plot_id") %>%
    mutate(state = st)
  
  # P50
  p50_result <- build_species_ba_by_plot(tree_df, species_with_p50, "P50_median")
  cwm_p50_all_states[[st]] <- compute_cwm(p50_result$species_ba, species_with_p50, "P50_median", "cwm_P50") %>%
    left_join(states_climate_data[[st]], by = "plot_id") %>%
    mutate(state = st)
}

cwm_tcrit_all_states_df <- bind_rows(cwm_tcrit_all_states)
cwm_p50_all_states_df <- bind_rows(cwm_p50_all_states)

# check the plot x INVYR combinations that we have trait data for all species
cwm_tcrit_all_states_df %>% count(state)
cwm_p50_all_states_df %>% count(state)

# check no plot_id appears under more than one state (should return 0 rows)
cwm_tcrit_all_states_df %>%
  distinct(plot_id, state) %>%
  count(plot_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# check every state you expect is present
table(cwm_tcrit_all_states_df$state)
```
